Name: BS's SDV Barrels
Author: baddiestardew
Description:
Adds new barrel decorations, plants and some logs. These are only retrieved from an item spawner and are all included in the base game, we just turned them into actual placeable items. More items coming soon.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download the CJB Item Spawner & Json Assets.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
IMPORTANT: This mod is not compatible with SVE. I believe they are purchasable from the Junimo woods later on. If you have SDV installed, uninstall my mod and just spawn the items in with the spawner.

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Press "i" on your keyboard to open the CJB Item Spawner and search for any of these items. (as of v. 1.0.0):
-Wood Barrel
-Wood Barrel L & Wood Barrel R
-Rock Crate
-Empty Pot
-Potted Ivy
-Log Bundle
These items can be placed on your farm & in your house:)

[b]AS OF V. 1.2.0:
[/b]Download "Robin Sells the Barrels" and Robin should sell the barrels every season for 100 gold each. This mod requires the Shop Tile Framework mod.

Downloads.Description: Robin will sell all the decorations for 100 gold each.
